subject.title: fix(security): bound mcporter registry read in audit

question: Should security audit report a warning when the mcporter registry exists but is rejected or cannot be inspected, or intentionally treat every such case as absent?
rationale: The resource cap is clearly desirable, but repository behavior does not establish whether incomplete MCP-registry inspection may remain silent; that security-audit contract determines the result type, finding ID, remediation text, and regression expectations.

options.title: Report incomplete inspection
options.body: Distinguish missing from rejected registries and emit a stable warning when audit cannot safely inspect an existing registry.

options.title: Accept fail-soft silence
options.body: Keep returning null for all failures and explicitly accept that oversized, malformed, unreadable, or non-regular registries suppress this audit coverage.

recommendation.title: Report incomplete inspection
recommendation.body: Distinguish missing from rejected registries and emit a stable warning when audit cannot safely inspect an existing registry.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history trail for security-audit policy and finding contracts points to repeated work across the central audit modules.
